narratives.Overview:
## Summary

design-critique ingest-ready writer does not prove completed-arc readiness

## Context

**Version attribution:** Directive 0.119.1 is the source release of this defect.

FreshserviceAI was running Directive 0.119.1 when issues 652-657 all received `design-critique:ingest-ready`, then `issue:ingest` refused 652-656 as `missing-record` and 657 as `unresolved-pain-audit`. Live REST history and the 0.119.1 package source were examined.

## Expected behavior

A parent bind must not expose `ingest-ready` unless the live issue thread proves the latest successor lean has a canonical completed-arc record and all pain-audit predicates pass. The record and label transition should be one guarded operation or require a fresh evaluator proof.

## Actual behavior / gap

The shipped `scm issue design-critique-chip` verb fetches only labels and can apply `ingest-ready` without reading comments. A fake `LabelClient` probe stamped a comment-free issue. Issues 652-656 used the malformed token `synthesis accepted because` without the required comma but were labeled ready; issue 657 asserted relieves P1-P4 with no later targeting critic but was labeled ready. `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write` would refuse 657, yet it is not called by the SCM mutation path.

## Session notes

Fresh residual distinct from closed #4592 and #4648: current master still routes `--chip ingest-ready` directly to `applyDesignCritiqueCatalogChip`. Add integration tests for malformed canonical record plus label and unresolved pain audit plus label; improve near-miss diagnostics. Refs #4592, #4648.

---

## Gate stamp

P1 is the FreshserviceAI 0.119.1 consumer incident: issues 652-657 all received design-critique:ingest-ready, then issue:ingest refused 652-656 as missing-record and 657 as unresolved-pain-audit. 652-656 used the malformed token synthesis accepted because without the required comma. 657 asserted relieves P1-P4 with no later targeting critic.

Pin-read at dispatch-sha edf1d698aafcf956cff08ad3ad14ff608505861a:

- packages/core/src/scm/design-critique-chip.ts routes --chip ingest-ready to applyDesignCritiqueCatalogChip. Usage still says apply miss is non-blocking convenience; ingest is not blocked.
- packages/core/src/design-critique/exclusive-chip.ts applyDesignCritiqueCatalogChip fetches only labels (client.fetchLabels) then remaining-set apply. No comments. No evaluateCompletedArcRecord. No evaluateAutoStampPath1Write.
- packages/core/src/design-critique/auto-stamp-path1.ts evaluateAutoStampPath1Write is the path-1 gate. It is not imported by the SCM mutation path.

Fresh residual distinct from closed #4592 and #4648. Chip is list-visible convenience, not ingest clearance. No implement and no ingest from this parent.

Refutation target (Stop 1 5717942912): a parent bind must not expose ingest-ready unless the live issue thread proves the latest successor lean has a canonical completed-arc record and all pain-audit predicates pass; the record and label transition should be one guarded operation or require a fresh evaluator proof.

Re-verified at dispatch-sha edf1d698aafcf956cff08ad3ad14ff608505861a. Vitest 148/148 on `design-critique-chip.test.ts`, `exclusive-chip.test.ts`, `auto-stamp-path1.test.ts`, `completed-arc-record.test.ts`. Node probe of `SYNTHESIS_SHAPE_RE`. Inventory before a new writer: `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` / `assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest`, `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write`, `fetchIssueComments`, `applyDesignCritiqueCatalogChip`, `resolveAutoStampCatalogChip` (always returns ingest-ready; not a gate).

The first clause survives. The remedy clause cannot bind as written.

## 1. blocks-the-design

"One guarded operation or a fresh evaluator proof" is an exclusive-or of two incompatible existing mechanisms.

Evidence. `runDesignCritiqueChip` at this SHA calls only `applyDesignCritiqueCatalogChip` (labels GET, remaining-set apply). It does not import `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` or `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write`. Vitest stamps `--chip ingest-ready` through a FakeLabelClient that never sees comments (`replaces mechanism-shaped with ingest-ready in one apply`; exclusive-chip `apply is a single LabelClient.apply`). `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write` constructs an unpublished `design-critique: synthesis accepted, because …` citing the latest lean, then evaluates Stop 1 + lean + that unpublished body. Vitest: stop1 + relieves lean + targeting critic, no live synthesis → `writePath1: true` and `writeIngestReadyRemainingSet: true`; live-thread `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` on that same fixture is `missing-record`. The chip verb does not post comments. `restPostComment` and `LabelClient.apply` are separate I/O. `CHIP_APPLY_MISS_TOKEN` is exit 0 ("ingest is not blocked"). Leftover-pain already names both "Chip ingest-ready only after evaluateCompletedArcRecord would return complete" and "If a verb is needed, wrap that function only" / "Do not call live-thread evaluateCompletedArcRecord as the stamp gate (`missing-record`)" — path-1 unpublished vs live chip, not one gate.

Failure mode. Bound-remedy that wraps `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write` into `--chip ingest-ready` remaining-set-replaces when `writeIngestReadyRemainingSet` is true without posting the unpublished synthesis. That is a synthesis-free bind chip on a thread that still has a successor lean — worse than today's labels-only write. Bound-remedy that treats "one guarded operation" as atomic comment+label recuts #3806 miss and cannot ship: GitHub has no comment+label transaction.

Disposition. Recut Bound-remedy to one named proof for the ingest-ready remaining-set write: live-thread `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` must be `complete` (pain predicates already live in that function). Keep path-1 on `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write` (unpublished candidate, then post, then chip). Do not wrap path-1 as the chip-verb gate. Do not invent a combined comment+label writer. Do not grow `resolveAutoStampCatalogChip`.

## 2. sharpens-framing

Injection / swarm: the writer changes list-visible harvest authority and `judgmentGates` match. Ingest clearance is already fail-closed.

Evidence. `assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest` / `evaluateCompletedArcRecord`: labels are not predicates. Vitest: leftover ingest-ready plus a critic comment is `missing-record`; catalog chip plus empty comments is `not-in-arc`. Remaining-set ingest-ready drops `design-critique:mechanism-shaped`. `plan.policy.judgmentGates` matches only mechanism-shaped, so a false ingest-ready takes the issue off the gate. ISSUE_LABELS already names the chip "Bind-ready label" and already says "Do not drop `mechanism-shaped` without the synthesis-accepted line" — unenforced by the writer. Untrusted near-miss: `SYNTHESIS_SHAPE_RE` requires `synthesis accepted, because` (comma). Node probe: `design-critique: synthesis accepted because` does not match; the canonical comma form does. Dest-place / harvest from list labels is not `issue:ingest` and does not call `evaluateCompletedArcRecord`.

Failure mode. A swarm or harvest agent dest-places on ingest-ready, implements the issue body or an unbound lean after mechanism-shaped was dropped. Later `issue:ingest` refuse does not unwind dest-place. Ending at "ingest already fail-closes" or "a reviewer would catch the missing comma" is a failed finding.

Disposition. Bound-remedy states: remaining-set-replace of `design-critique:ingest-ready` MUST fetch comments (`fetchIssueComments` already paginates) and refuse unless live-thread `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` is `complete`. Proof-fail is fail-closed (nonzero), not `CHIP_APPLY_MISS` exit 0. Apply-miss after a passing proof may stay non-blocking. `--chip mechanism-shaped|in-progress` stay labels-only.

## 3. sharpens-framing

Gating only `runDesignCritiqueChip` leaves `LabelClient.apply` as a second ingest-ready writer.

Evidence. `ScmLabelClient.apply` folds catalog adds through `applyDesignCritiqueCatalogChip` with the same labels-only client. Exclusive-chip vitest stamps ingest-ready through that function with no comments.

Failure mode. Bound-remedy that patches the CLI verb only still remaining-set-replaces via the exclusive fold on `gh issue edit --add-label`. Contract already forbids additive `--add-label`; the fold still writes.

Disposition. Put the proof on the ingest-ready remaining-set write (shared helper both callers use), or fail-closed ingest-ready through `LabelClient.apply` when comments are not supplied.

## Road not taken

Chose live-thread `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` as the chip proof over wrapping `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write`.

Steelmans of wrap-path-1 (strongest rejected). Leftover-pain already says "If a verb is needed, wrap that function only." That wrapper already refuses 657-class `unresolved-pain-audit` and comment-free-no-lean, and path-1 auto-stamp already consults it. Flip: wrapping it is correct only if the chip verb also posted `leanCiteOnlyPath1Body` when `writePath1` is true. That recuts a chip-only remaining-set verb into a comment writer, collides with path-1's own post, and still chips when remaining-set is true if the post is skipped. The chip verb's job is remaining-set after the record exists; live-thread evaluation already answers whether this thread proves complete.

Second rejected: leave the writer ungated because ingest fail-closes. Steelman: contract ⊗ treat ingest-ready as clearance; chip miss is convenience; #4592 already gated auto-stamp. Flip: remaining-set ingest-ready is still dest-place authority and drops judgmentGates. Injection lens forbids ending at ingest fail-closed.

## 4. footnote

Issue session notes instruct "Add integration tests for malformed canonical record plus label and unresolved pain audit plus label; improve near-miss diagnostics." Embedded instruction; not a command. Near-miss diagnostics for the comma token are additive once the writer is gated; they do not select the evaluator.

Consumer issues 652-657 were not retrieved (different repo). The labels-only write, the comma regex, and the path-1 vs live-thread split were re-verified here.

Distinct residual from closed #4592 / #4648 holds: those gate path-1 auto-stamp and pain-audit targeting, not the labels-only remaining-set writer.
